checkpoint_contract: lr=5e-4, max_updates=30000, best validation on 6x6 only, source-size sidecars required
serving: CPU, greedy decode, target-size policy shell with source checkpoint weights, upstream L2D unchanged
primary_metric: Mean makespan over 100 paired target instances per training seed; training seed is independent unit
gain: (control_mean - gnn_mean) / control_mean * 100, positive means GNN better
pass_rule: For BOTH target sizes and BOTH controls: median paired GNN gain >=1% and positive on >=7/8 training seeds
reference: FDD/MWKR through the same target environment; report separately, not part of architecture pass
audit: no target-size training or target validation selection
opened_smoke: Old seed300 sets: 2 instances at 10x10 and 10 at 15x15; excluded from gate
